# Knovas Link

> The one program at a company's site that talks to Knovas, outwards only, so that the site's other components reach the Platform and the Brain only through its local API.

## Identity

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `L3-KNOVAS-LINK` |
| Kind | code |
| Owner | `ROLE-ENGINE-OWNER` |
| Status | planned |
| Level | 3 |
| Parent | `L2-CONNECTION` |

## Purpose

### Responsible for

| Id | Statement | Code |
|---|---|---|
| `L3-KNOVAS-LINK/R-1` | The site's identity - its key (made on site, never sent), the enrolment with the Platform and the site's own client certificate. | `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/identity.py`; `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/certificate.py`; `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/link.py` |
| `L3-KNOVAS-LINK/R-2` | The control plane with the Platform (heartbeat with the site's telemetry, configuration, package, commands, reports) for itself and for the components behind it. | `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/link.py`; `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/platform_client.py`; `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/telemetry.py` |
| `L3-KNOVAS-LINK/R-3` | The work channel - claiming the Brain's jobs for the site's sources and carrying them, their parts and their results between the Brain and the component that serves the source; and the probes. | `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/jobs.py`; `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/brain_client.py` |
| `L3-KNOVAS-LINK/R-4` | The local API for the site's components, a token per component, and the relay of their Brain calls on an allow-list. | `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/local_api.py`; `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/registry.py`; `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/relay.py` |
| `L3-KNOVAS-LINK/R-5` | The shared contract files it is built against (job, result and stream schemas, codes, local API), pinned by contracts.lock. | `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/contracts.py`; `KnovasLink/contracts/contracts.lock` |
| `L3-KNOVAS-LINK/R-6` | Connector protocol 2.0 (draft), only while LINK_PROTOCOL_V2 is on - the site declaration to the Brain, the pinned permit keys, the permit checks before an act reaches its connector, the used-permit store with the first result for a repeat, the site's write log, and the routing of the v2 jobs to the connector that declared the action. | `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/protocol_v2.py`; `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/permits.py`; `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/write_path.py`; `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/jobs.py`; `KnovasLink/contracts/v2/contracts.lock` |

### Not responsible for

- Reading a source; that is a component's job (today the sync component).
- Holding a source's credential; it stays in the component's environment.
- Signing the site's certificate; a Knovas admin signs it and the Builder records it.

### Terms

- site (one machine at a company, one Docker network)
- component (a program beside Link that reads a source)
- work channel (the long-poll on which the Brain hands out jobs)
- lease (the claim's token, sent back with every part and result)

## Offers

### Operations

| Id | Name | Entrance | Ref |
|---|---|---|---|
| `local.register` | POST /local/v1/register - a component says its kind, version, capabilities and job kinds | http | `POST /local/v1/register` |
| `local.heartbeat` | POST /local/v1/heartbeat - a component's heartbeat; the Platform's commands come back | http | `POST /local/v1/heartbeat` |
| `local.command-done` | POST /local/v1/commands/{command_id}/done | http | `POST /local/v1/commands/{command_id}/done` |
| `local.config` | GET /local/v1/config | http | `GET /local/v1/config` |
| `local.package` | GET /local/v1/package | http | `GET /local/v1/package` |
| `local.ping` | GET /local/v1/ping | http | `GET /local/v1/ping` |
| `local.jobs` | GET /local/v1/jobs?wait=0..25 - a component's long-poll for its next job | http | `GET /local/v1/jobs` |
| `local.job-part` | POST /local/v1/jobs/{job_id}/part?n=N - one part of a fetch | http | `POST /local/v1/jobs/{job_id}/part` |
| `local.job-result` | POST /local/v1/jobs/{job_id}/result | http | `POST /local/v1/jobs/{job_id}/result` |
| `local.brain-relay` | ANY /local/v1/brain/{path} - a component's Brain call, relayed | http | `/local/v1/brain/{path}` |
| `local.report` | POST /local/v1/report/{kind} - runs, events or checks of a component | http | `POST /local/v1/report/{kind}` |
| `cli.knovas_link.__main__` | python -m knovas_link - start Link (the image's entry point) | cli | `python -m knovas_link` |
| `certificate-request` | python -m knovas_link certificate-request - print the site's certificate request | cli | `python -m knovas_link certificate-request` |
| `certificate-fingerprint` | python -m knovas_link certificate-fingerprint - print the request's public-key fingerprint | cli | `python -m knovas_link certificate-fingerprint` |
| `install-certificate` | python -m knovas_link install-certificate [FILE\|-] - install the certificate Knovas signed | cli | `python -m knovas_link install-certificate` |
| `work-channel` | The work channel - a long-poll claiming the Brain's jobs for the site's sources | queue | `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/jobs.py#WorkChannel.run` |
| `heartbeat-loop` | The heartbeat to the Platform, every LINK_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS | job | `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/link.py#Link._control_loop` |
| `probe-loop` | The probe of the work channel, every LINK_PROBE_SECONDS and on the Platform's check command | job | `KnovasLink/src/knovas_link/link.py#Link._probe_loop` |

## Hides

- The key size (RSA 3072) and the layout of the /data volume.
- The order in which held jobs are handed out within one component's queue.
- How many finished jobs Link remembers to answer a repeated claim (500).

## Pattern

None stated.

## Decisions and risks

### Decisions

| Id | Statement |
|---|---|
| `DEC-0056` | Every site's Link has its own certificate from Knovas's client CA (option A, A1); until it is installed Link claims no job, sends no probe and relays nothing. |
| `DEC-0062` | Later the issuance job signs with the HSM-held client CA key; until then one Knovas admin confirms and signs. |
| `DEC-0040` | The tenant's own certificate is only to test on one's own machine, never for a company. |

### Risks

| Id | Statement | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| `L3-KNOVAS-LINK/RISK-01` | Jobs are not bound to one site - any certificate of the tenant that names the source can claim a fetch or write job; needed before a tenant has a second site. | Add a second site only after jobs name a certificate serial (README, "Not built yet"). |
| `L3-KNOVAS-LINK/RISK-02` | The relay passes every method below secured/graph/. | Accepted until the first external customer (connector protocol v1.1, "Sites and Knovas Link"). |
